10.evidenceText: Multiple prices found: €3.78 (ebike24), €11.99, €3.79, €9.99, €8.99, €3.99 (bike-discount). Median of 6 prices = €6.49
10.extractionRationale: Six distinct retail prices were extracted from the sources: €3.78, €3.79, €3.99, €8.99, €9.99, and €11.99. These represent various Clik Valve products and variants. The median value of these six prices is €6.49 (average of the 3rd and 4th values when sorted).

27.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve - Tubeless-Ventil - 2er Set - 80 mm
27.evidenceText: Four distinct product pages identified: p1859950 (80mm), p1859948 (40mm), p1859951 (Umrüstkit), p1859953 (Umrüstkit variant). Source 5 is a category page, not a product listing.
27.extractionRationale: Counted unique product page URLs with distinct product IDs (p1859950, p1859948, p1859951, p1859953). Each has a different product offering - varying lengths and kit types. The category page (Source 5) was excluded as it is not a distinct product listing. No duplicates identified.

30.sourceTitle: BBB Cycling CoreCap BTI-165 Valve Core - copper
30.evidenceText: No content provided in the product listing data
30.extractionRationale: Both product listing sources have empty content sections, making it impossible to determine stock status from the available text. Stock status indicators such as 'out of stock', 'currently unavailable', 'nicht verfügbar', or 'ausverkauft' cannot be identified when no product page content is available.

36.evidenceText: The provided source content discusses Clik Valve pump head adapters and compatibility information but does not contain any data about "frequently bought together," "related products" sections, or metrics indicating what fraction of product pages display accessory recommendations.
36.extractionRationale: No direct evidence in the source indicates the presence or percentage of product pages showing accessory attach rates. The content discusses product features and compatibility but not sales/merchandising data about accessory cross-selling displays.

37.evidenceText: The provided content discusses valve installation, dust cap removal, and product availability but does not specify replacement/spare part SKUs, valve cores, seals, o-rings, or replacement kit quantities.
37.extractionRationale: The evidence does not contain explicit information about distinct replacement/spare part SKUs for the Clik Valve. No specific counts or lists of valve cores, seals, o-rings, or replacement kits are provided in the source material.

45.evidenceText: Hunt wheels specs include rim depth, width, weight details but no mention of Clik valve adoption or 2026/2027 product lines. No evidence of Clik valve adoption by Hunt or other major brands (DT Swiss, Mavic, Zipp, ENVE, Roval).
45.extractionRationale: The provided source contains no information about Clik valve adoption by any major wheelset brands. The article discusses Hunt wheel specifications but does not mention valve types or future product line standards. No evidence supports adoption by any of the six major brands mentioned, therefore 0% have converted.

49.evidenceText: The evidence shows "Clik Valves" mentioned in relation to an external Cyclocross Magazine article review, not as part of the actual bike specifications for either the 2026 Bergamont Grandurance 10 or 2025 Bergamont Grandurance LTD models.
49.extractionRationale: No bicycle models in the provided evidence show Clik valve listed in their actual product specifications. The only mentions of "Clik Valves" appear in references to an external Cyclocross Magazine review article, not as component specifications for the bikes themselves.

50.evidenceText: Distinct Clik valve technical/installation pages identified: (1) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/clik-valve (English technical page), (2) https://www.schwalbe.com/clik-valve-ventil (German technical page), (3) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/SCHWALBE-CLIK-VALVE-TUBELESS-VENTIL-3531 (Tubeless variant page). The press page was excluded as it is not a technical document, installation guide, or FAQ.
50.extractionRationale: Counted unique URLs containing Clik valve technical documentation, installation guides, or FAQ-type content. Excluded the press page (https://www.schwalbe.com/en/press/clik-valve) as it serves a different purpose. Sources 3 and 4 refer to the same page (one http, one https with www - same canonical page). Three distinct technical/installation pages were identified.

61.evidenceText: Three-month LME aluminum futures rose 1.7% to $3,571 per metric ton in mid-morning European trading on April 13, their highest level since March 2022.
61.extractionRationale: The LME 3M aluminum spot price is directly stated as $3,571 USD/t in all three sources. This is the current spot price as of April 13, already expressed in USD per metric ton as required.

62.sourceTitle: Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest Price Today - Investing.com
62.evidenceText: Prev. Close: 1,793.99 (Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest, symbol LUPc1)
62.extractionRationale: The source displays 1,793.99 as the previous close price for the Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest. Given the magnitude of this number and standard market conventions, this value is in cents per pound. Converting to USD/lb: 1,793.99 cents ÷ 100 = 17.9399, rounded to 17.94 USD/lb.
